        "contents": "export class ProjectController {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 获取项目列表\n   */\n  async getAll(req: Request, res: Response) {\n    try {\n      const {\n        page = 1,\n        pageSize = 20,\n        orderBy = 'created_at',\n        orderDirection = 'DESC',\n        status,\n        type\n      } = req.query;\n\n      const options = {\n        limit: parseInt(pageSize as string),\n        offset: (parseInt(page as string) - 1) * parseInt(pageSize as string),\n        orderBy: orderBy as string,\n        orderDirection: orderDirection as 'ASC' | 'DESC',\n        where: {} as any\n      };\n\n      if (status) {\n        options.where.status = status;\n      } else {\n        // 默认只显示活跃状态\n        options.where.status = ProjectStatus.ACTIVE;\n      }\n\n      if (type) {\n        options.where.type = type;\n      }\n\n      const result = await projectModel.findAll(options);\n      \n      // 为每个项目添加来源数量和技术点数量\n      const projectsWithCounts = await Promise.all(\n        result.data.map(async (project) =&gt; {\n          const [sourceCount, techPointCount] = await Promise.all([\n            projectModel.getSourceCount(project.id),\n            projectModel.getTechPointCount(project.id)\n          ]);\n          return {\n            ...project,\n            sourceCount,\n            techPointCount\n          };\n        })\n      );\n\n      res.json({\n        success: true,\n        data: {\n          ...result,\n          data: projectsWithCounts\n        }\n      });\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Get projects error:', error);\n      res.status(500).json({\n        success: false,\n        message: '获取项目列表失败',\n        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'\n      });\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 获取精选项目\n   */\n  async getFeatured(req: Request, res: Response) {\n    try\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "-- 项目数据管理重构迁移脚本\n-- 创建日期: 2025-12-05\n-- 说明: 重构项目数据管理架构，以\"项目\"为核心关联所有相关数据\n\n-- ==============================================\n-- 1. 确保 projects 表存在（如果不存在则创建）\n-- ==============================================\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS projects (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    name TEXT NOT NULL,\n    description TEXT,\n    cover_image TEXT,\n    icon TEXT,\n    type TEXT DEFAULT 'normal' CHECK (type IN ('normal', 'featured')),\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived', 'deleted')),\n    created_by TEXT,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    last_opened_at DATETIME\n);\n\n-- ==============================================\n-- 2. 项目关联基础信息表（多对多关系）\n-- ==============================================\n\n-- 项目与技术点关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_tech_points (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    project_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    notes TEXT,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    UNIQUE(project_id, tech_point_id)\n);\n\n-- 项目与公开知识点关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_knowledge_points (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    project_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    knowledge_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    notes TEXT,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (knowledge_point_id) REFERENCES knowledge_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    UNIQUE(project_id, knowledge_point_id)\n);\n\n-- 项目与文件关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_files (\n    ",

        "contents": "| &#96;ai_roles&#96; | ✅ 已实现 | 27 | AI角色配置 |\n| &#96;public_page_configs&#96; | ✅ 已实现 | - | 公开页面配置 |\n| &#96;page_tool_configs&#96; | ✅ 已实现 | - | 页面工具配置 |\n| &#96;files&#96; | ✅ 已实现 | - | 文件存储 |\n| &#96;workflow_stats_summary&#96; | ✅ 已实现 | - | 工作流统计汇总 |\n\n### ✅ 项目管理层（新增，已实现）\n\n| 表名 | 状态 | 记录数 | 说明 |\n|------|------|--------|------|\n| &#96;projects&#96; | ✅ 已实现 | 4 | 项目表（核心聚合实体） |\n| &#96;project_sources&#96; | ✅ 已实现 | 0 | 项目来源表 |\n| &#96;project_tech_points&#96; | ✅ 已实现 | 0 | 项目与技术点关联 |\n| &#96;project_knowledge_points&#96; | ✅ 已实现 | 0 | 项目与知识点关联 |\n| &#96;project_files&#96; | ✅ 已实现 | 0 | 项目与文件关联 |\n\n**说明**: 项目管理功能是代码中大量使用的功能，但之前数据库缺失，现已补充。\n\n### ✅ AI搜索层（已实现）\n\n| 表名 | 状态 | 记录数 | 说明 |\n|------|------|--------|------|\n| &#96;ai_search_conversations&#96; | ✅ 已实现 | 296,279 | AI搜索对话 |\n| &#96;ai_search_messages&#96; | ✅ 已实现 | 84 | AI搜索消息 |\n| &#96;ai_search_outputs&#96; | ✅ 已实现 | 0 | AI搜索输出 |\n| &#96;ai_search_field_mappings&#96; | ✅ 已实现 | - | AI搜索字段映射 |\n\n## 二、架构策略说明\n\n### 2.1 轻量级JSON存储策略\n\n**适用场景**: AI生成的内容（技术包装、策略、通稿、演讲稿）\n\n**优势**:\n- ✅ 减少表数量，降低维护复杂度\n- ✅ 灵活存储不同结构的内容\n- ✅ 快速迭代，无需频繁迁移\n- ✅ 符合\"临时生成、立即使用\"的业务场景\n\n**存储位置**: &#96;workflow_executions.outputs&#96; (JSON字段)\n\n**示例结构**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"tech_package\": {\n    \"title\": \"技术包装标题\",\n    \"content\": \"技术包装内容...\",\n    \"generated_at\": \"2025-01-06T10:00:00Z\"\n  },\n  \"promotion_strategy\": {\n    \"title\": \"推广策略标题\",\n    \"content\": \"推广策略内容...\",\n    \"channels\": [\"social_media\", \"blog\"]\n  }\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 2.2 结构化存储策略",

        "contents": "';\n\nconst ProjectResourcesPage: React.FC = () =&gt; {\n  const { projectId } = useParams&lt;{ projectId: string }&gt;();\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n  const location = useLocation();\n  const [searchParams, setSearchParams] = useSearchParams();\n  \n  const [project, setProject] = useState&lt;Project | null&gt;(null);\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);\n  const [sources, setSources] = useState&lt;SourceInformation[]&gt;([]);\n  const [isTechPointsLoaded, setIsTechPointsLoaded] = useState(false);\n  \n  // 从 localStorage 恢复已选择的技术点（使用函数式初始化）\n  const [selectedTechPoints, setSelectedTechPoints] = useState&lt;number[]&gt;(() =&gt; {\n    if (!projectId) return [];\n    try {\n      const stored = localStorage.getItem(&#96;project-${projectId}-selectedTechPoints&#96;);\n      if (stored) {\n        const parsed = JSON.parse(stored);\n        return Array.isArray(parsed) ?         "contents": "const TechPointDetailPanel: React.FC&lt;TechPointDetailPanelProps&gt; = \n\n\n  const renderKnowledgePoints = () =&gt; {\n    if (knowledgePoints &amp;&amp; knowledgePoints.length &gt; 0) {\n      const groupedByTitle: Record&lt;string, KnowledgePoint[]&gt; = {};\n      knowledgePoints.forEach(kp =&gt; {\n        let title = kp.title || '未分类';\n        const titleMatch = title.match(/^(.+?)\\s+\\d+$/);\n        if (titleMatch) {\n          title = titleMatch[1];\n        }\n        \n        if (!groupedByTitle[title]) {\n          groupedByTitle[title] = [];\n        }\n        groupedByTitle[title].push(kp);\n      });\n\n      const titleOrder = ['技术原理', '价值', '适用边界', '技术亮点', '实测证据', '认证证据', '对比证据'];\n      const sortedTitles = Object.keys(groupedByTitle).sort((a, b) =&gt; {\n        const indexA = titleOrder.indexOf(a);\n        const indexB = titleOrder.indexOf(b);\n        if (indexA !== -1 &amp;&amp; indexB !== -1) return indexA - indexB;\n        if (indexA !== -1) return -1;\n        if (indexB !== -1) return 1;\n        return a.localeCompare(b);\n      });\n\n      return (\n        &lt;div className=\"space-y-3\"&gt;\n          {sortedTitles.map((title) =&gt; {\n            const kps = groupedByTitle[title];\n            return (\n              &lt;div key={title}&gt;\n                &lt;Text strong className=\"text-sm\"&gt;- {title}：&lt;/Text&gt;\n                &lt;div className=\"ml-4 mt-1\"&gt;\n                  {kps.length === 1 ?
